newsitem.title: USA: U.S. House Democratic leader opposes new Fed hike.
newsitem.headline: U.S. House Democratic leader opposes new Fed hike.

text.p: House Democratic Leader Richard Gephardt of Missouri said Thursday he, Sen. Tom Harkin, R-Iowa, and other members of Congress were sending a letter to Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan urging the Fed not to raise interest rates again at its next meeting in May.

The Fed raised interest rates by one-quarter of a point at its last meeting in late March. "Another rate increase at the May 20 meeting could put a severe clamp on economic growth," Gephart said in a statement. The letter will be made public Friday.
